summary: Iter 64 verification: Easebuzz-only refund system + agency earnings + Razorpay removal. Backend: 13/13 tests pass (including 2 refund unit tests with mocked Easebuzz Refund API). Frontend smoke: Admin Refunds tab renders correctly, Booking Flow Step 5 is Easebuzz-only (no Razorpay imports/UI in BookingFlow.jsx or PaymentStep.jsx), Agency Earnings drawer opens and renders bookings table for ACTIVE artists (DJ Vortex, Priya Sharma). One minor UX issue found: Earnings button is shown for PENDING agency roster artists too, but backend returns 404 for them and the drawer stays blank.

minor.issue: Returns 404 when the artist is in the agency roster but has status='pending' (invited-not-yet-accepted). Frontend still exposes an 'Earnings' button for them, resulting in a blank drawer. Either return 200 with empty totals/bookings, or hide the button on the frontend for pending rows. Repro: login agency@booktalent.com, /agency/artists, click Earnings on 'Deepika Rao' (status PENDING) — GET /api/agency/artist/c57bc45c-d236-4a47-a94a-4241f65e4c61/earnings → 404.

ui_bugs.issue: For PENDING roster artists, the drawer opens, loading spinner disappears, but nothing renders (no bookings table, no empty state) because the API 404's. Consider disabling the Earnings action when status !== 'active', or handling the 404 with a friendly 'Earnings not available until the artist accepts the invite' message.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Improve UX around Earnings button for PENDING agency-roster artists — either return 200 with empty payload from /api/agency/artist/{id}/earnings, or hide the button until status==active.
critical_code_review_comments: Razorpay is verifiably removed from all critical paths: BookingFlow.jsx, PaymentStep.jsx have zero razorpay refs. Only legacy filter values 'razorpay' / 'razorpay_mock' remain as historical dropdown options inside AdminPaymentReconciliation.jsx, which is intentional for viewing legacy DB rows.

Removed endpoints (/payments/init, /payments/verify, /payments/webhook, /payments/config, /payments/batch/init, /payments/batch/verify, /payments/{id}/refund) all return 404/405 → confirmed not routable.
/api/admin/refunds/{id}/retry endpoint exists (returns 4xx for unknown id, not 404 route-not-found).

auto_refund helper: success path marks payment.status='refunded' + records refund_id/refund_amount/refund_status='successful'; failure path records refund_status='failed' + refund_error + creates admin notification of type='refund.failed'. Idempotency guard prevents duplicate refunds via refund_status=='successful' check.

/api/agency/artist/{id}/earnings returns full totals block (total_earnings, completed_earnings, upcoming_earnings, confirmed_booking_value, completed_events, upcoming_events, commission_pct, agency_commission_earned) plus per-booking fields (ref, event_date, customer_name, artist_fee, platform_charges, agency_commission, status, payment_status, refund_status) — matches spec exactly.
Confirmed no created_at filter on agency earnings endpoint — newly-added agencies see historical bookings for the artist.
Booking rejection on a pending_payment booking transitions status to 'rejected' cleanly with no refund attempt (no completed payment exists) — no crash.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical smoke passes; 1 minor UX issue on pending artist earnings)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. test_iter64_refunds.py stages then cleans up its own payment/notification/user docs. test_iter64_review.py creates one live booking as customer@booktalent.com against DJ Vortex which is then rejected by admin (stays in DB in 'rejected' state, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For Iter 64: run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter64_refunds.py /app/backend/tests/test_iter64_review.py -v`. Frontend Earnings drawer works via /agency/artists route (not /agency). Only ACTIVE agency-roster artists have valid earnings endpoints; PENDING roster artists 404. Admin Payment Reconciliation is reached via /admin then click 'Payment Reconciliation' link — the Refunds tab has data-testid='tab-refunds'. Booking Flow PaymentStep uses data-testid='easebuzz-summary' + 'pay-now-btn' with no Razorpay code anywhere.
rca of the issue: Minor Earnings-on-pending-artist issue: /api/agency/artist/{id}/earnings (in agency_roster.py) likely does a lookup that requires the artist to have accepted the roster invite. When status=='pending' the join/filter returns no artist record → 404. Mitigation: either (a) in the endpoint, when the roster entry exists but the artist has no bookings yet, return 200 with zeroed totals and empty bookings[]; or (b) in Artists.jsx, conditionally render the Earnings button only when r.status === 'active'.
